items.headline: SN106 Nodexo raises its owner allocation to 33% in a finalized transaction
items.summary: At 16:36 UTC on November 2, successful transaction 9419475-30 changed Nodexo’s five-slot alpha-emission vector from 0/0/18/41/41 to 0/0/33/30/37 (burn/recycle/owner/validators/miners, rounded percentages). The owner bucket rises 15 percentage points, validators fall 11 and miners fall 4. Storage immediately before and after the event, successful proxy execution, and unchanged registration identity were checked. Root is paid its live baseline first, capped by the validator allocation; reported yields can lag the change. This is not a token sale, revenue measure or guaranteed APY.

items.headline: SN54 Yanez reports its first week of eTAO results, with variable yields

These are the team’s reported observations, not independently reconstructed returns or proof that the split alone caused the changes. Its follow-up explicitly says APY moves with total stake and emissions. The figures are historical observations, not an offer of fixed yield.

items.headline: SN116 Carbon reports Control Center launch and tougher testnet challenges
items.summary: Carbon’s November 2 development update says its Control Center is launched for registered miners, bringing challenge, compute, inference and agent choices into one workflow. This matters because high test scores did not necessarily produce the physics-learning models the team wanted. The original post keeps upgraded mainnet challenges upcoming; no completed mainnet launch or commercial model qualification is claimed.
